fullPassage: Many products for sale at local supermarkets contain a chemical called bisphenol A, more commonly known as BPA. BPA can be found in plastics used to make food containers and baby bottles. It is also used to protect the inside of metal food cans. These products can cause people to be exposed to BPA through their diet. This is because BPA may leak out of these containers and into the food itself. BPA is harmful to the body because its structure is similar to that of natural hormones. This similarity makes it easy for vital bodily functions to be negatively affected. Whether or not BPA should be banned is controversial, but many experts consider it unwise to use products that contain BPA.

questions.passage: Many products for sale at local supermarkets contain a chemical called bisphenol A, more commonly known as BPA. BPA can be found in plastics used to make food containers and baby bottles. It is also used to protect the inside of metal food cans. These products can cause people to be exposed to BPA through their diet. This is because BPA may leak out of these containers and into the food itself. BPA is harmful to the body because its structure is similar to that of natural hormones. This similarity makes it easy for vital bodily functions to be negatively affected. Whether or not BPA should be banned is controversial, but many experts consider it unwise to use products that contain BPA.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: BPA는 유해할 수 있어 함유 제품 사용에 주의(전문가들도 unwise로 봄)
det.analysis:
① BPA가 유해할 수 있어 사용에 주의 필요 → 마지막 문장 'many experts consider it unwise to use products that contain BPA'와 부합 ←정답
② 안전한 물질: 본문은 유해성 경고 — 반대
③ 전면 금지: 금지 여부는 '논란거리'일 뿐
④ 건강에 유익: 부정적 영향 언급과 반대
det.tip: 전문가들이 사용을 unwise라 봄 → 주의 필요가 요지

ch: BPA는 인체에 해로울 수 있으므로 이를 함유한 제품 사용에 주의가 필요하다.
BPA는 식품 용기 제조에 반드시 필요한 안전한 물질이다.
BPA는 이미 모든 국가에서 사용이 전면 금지되었다.
BPA는 천연 호르몬과 같은 기능을 하여 건강에 유익하다.
